HRA Analysis: MEZZANOTTI (5) returns to a much easier race today after running in the Southern cross series and some tricky races in Melbourne. If she is anywhere near her best she will be the one to beat. CAPTAIN CAROLINE (6), JILLIBY ECLIPSE (1) and CLARENDEN REGALIA (3) are also chances.

LOW LIE THE FIELDS (8) has the runs on the board when it comes to recent form. He has won four of his last five starts and has been hitting the line well. He is a major chance to win again today. MILITARY MERIT (7) is a big threat but he is first up from a spell. If he can get some clear air he will love the mobile start and the distance. NOTHING I WANT (4) has race fitness on her side but she has had chances to win races recently and she hasn’t got the job done. MAJESTIC TUSSLE (3) is a chance but she is first up.

TREACHEROUS DAN (6) gets a major drop down in class today after competing in the Southern Cross series but the draw over the shorter journey is a concern. He will need some luck but he looks a class above. ORSINO BELLE (8) has her first South Australian start for Kaycee Carey. Her NSW form reads well and she is worth consideration today. LIGHTNING BLING (7) and LOCHINVAR HAWK (3) are also chances.

KENZINGTON (8) is very green but she is another who finds a much easier race after competing in the Southern Cross series. If she can pace smoothly she will be hard to beat. JUST VIENNA (4) is showing signs of improvement and she looks like a big threat today as well. ULTIMATE SAFARI (3) and VINNIES HOPE (9) are also chances.

TWIN CONNECTION (9) ran a nice race at Globe Derby last start when he was three wide for a lot of the last lap and ran second behind OHSO KINKY. The second row draw isn’t ideal, but he looks strong enough to overcome it after that terrific run last start. LE GASTON (6) is another who is stepping down in class today after running in the Southern Cross. He is a big threat today. TRIGGER (1) and STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (5) look the next best.

SANTA CASA LANE (4) has shown signs since returning from a long spell and joining the Mel Kittel stable. Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky will make a major difference and if he can repeat some of the form he showed early in his preparation he will be a big chance. B T CAPTIVATE (7) will need some luck from the second row but he is good enough to win this if he can get the right run into the race. TWO WAY WONDER (1) is a good chance of holding the lead from the inside draw. BETTOR LOVER (6) is also a chance.

FIRESIDE (10) was extremely impressive two starts ago but very disappointing last week. He will need to improve off that run but he is a major chance if he is anywhere near his best. PARISIAN BANDIT (8), OAKLANDER (6) and DONT TELL ALICE (5) are all major chances in a very even race. OVERVIEW:MAURLEN COMPASS (2) isn't blessed with gate speed but has been finishing her races off well and drops back significantly in class after a decent performance against much stronger opposition in the Oaks. She'll need to map reasonably well over the distance, but she should appreciate this level and get the chance to show her class in a suitable race. MAJOR ORION (3) is a quick beginner and looks likely to cross to the pegs and lead these, which is a big advantage at Echuca, particularly over the short trip. He put in a bad run two starts back, but that was an outlier in what's been a very good season for him. He's had only one start at this track for a win, and although this is slightly harder, he'll take some catching. OWEN THE SAINTS (8) was a good winner last week when able to lead all the way at Shepparton but goes from the front to the back row now, with a few strong runners drawn ahead of him. He must still be respected. WICKED MITZI (5) found a decent draw last time and was able to put her best foot forward in a much stronger race. She draws a little awkwardly but is a winner at this track, which is a plus. OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (1), MISTER JIMARINGLE (4) and LINE DANCE (7) can all map reasonably well and have minor claims. BACK: MAURLEN COMPASS (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MAURLEN COMPASS (2), MAJOR ORION (3), OWEN THE SAINTS (8), WICKED MITZI (5)

OVERVIEW:MUSSEL SHOALS (3) gets a great draw to find the front here, a position where she always delivers her best performances. She led last time over this trip, but that was a much stronger race where she was forced to run a fast time, and she seems less likely to face the same pressure here. She has a good record at this track and will take some catching. WHERES WOOD WOOD (7) is racing in career-best form, and even though she's missed a place in her past three starts, she's still raced honestly. This is her home track, and she loves it here, so while she'll need luck from the draw, she's a strong chance. FLIP A COIN (1) is first up and doesn't have great numerical form, but his best efforts last preparation have him well in this, and he draws to map softly. TALKNPLAY (9) has been in career-best form this preparation, winning three from four. It's a different challenge now from the back row and against some in-form types, but he's in the mix. ARMOURY (6) has been racing well in two runs for the new stable, so keep him safe despite the draw. EEBEEBEE (8) is fitter second up and might be worth considering for the minor money, trailing through off the back row. BACK: MUSSEL SHOALS (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MUSSEL SHOALS (3), WHERES WOOD WOOD (7), FLIP A COIN (1), TALKNPLAY (9)

OVERVIEW:ALTO CORAGGIO (4) has been runner-up in all five career starts, and surely tonight's the night he breaks through for a victory. While he led and had his chance last week, the winner might be pretty good, and you can make a case that he's run well in all his narrow defeats. He looks likely to find the lead here, take control and won't find a more suitable race to break his maiden. THE PRIVATE DEAL (1) will need a scratching to get into the field. He's had three runs for the new stable and has earned market respect despite not looking well suited in most of those races. He now gets a draw and the right opposition to make an impact. He may be a bit tricky at the start, but if he's safely away, he'll be a threat. CARTIMANDUA (2) draws softly with a good driver, and while she'll need to improve on recent efforts, that map prominence will help in a race like this. Likewise for ALCATRAZ MISS (3), a 39-start maiden who's been getting closer in her past few. RISE AGAIN (6) goes to the astute Ashwood stable, which can improve these lower-rated types quickly, so watch the betting. BACK: ALTO CORAGGIO (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALTO CORAGGIO (4), THE PRIVATE DEAL (1), RISE AGAIN (6), CARTIMANDUA (2)

OVERVIEW:SPIRIT OF SPITFIRE (3) is a fascinating runner, being a former New Zealander who had two trials in NSW, switched stables, had a run in Adelaide with a solid SP and now races here with top driver James Herbertson booked. No question she'll attract plenty of market interest, and while you're guessing a bit with what's exposed, the positive indicators suggest she's a strong chance. MAURLEN GRACE (4) was held up badly last week. She was buried back after being slow to begin before galloping when looking a strong chance along the passing lane. There appears to be improvement this preparation, so she's a chance again. ASHANTE WARRIOR (9) has found good form for the Ashwood stable, winning last week in a suitable race, but the draw makes things harder this time. FRESH PRINCE (1) has his second run for the Carbone stable, and while he'll need to lift on that first-up effort, the draw offers a chance to atone. CALIVIL (8) is first up since February and has won a trial leading into this. I'd prefer his chances with more fitness, but don't dismiss him entirely. SELECTIONS:SPIRIT OF SPITFIRE (3), MAURLEN GRACE (4), ASHANTE WARRIOR (9), FRESH PRINCE (1)

OVERVIEW: A tricky start to the Quaddie, with several of these trotters either not in peak form or with fitness to come. FARSTAR (4) goes back to the front row and a draw that saw him lead and win three runs back at Shepparton, albeit in slow time. Having top driver Mark Pitt aboard gives confidence he'll be hard to beat against these. SAINT EYES (2) has gone close in his past couple of runs and draws softly to be in the mix again. His last win in April saw him beat stronger types than he meets now. ITS DIAMOND CREEK (5) is first up for over a year with two trials under his belt and a stable switch back to former trainer Jenny Johnson. He has gate speed and did seem to be nearing another win last preparation. LITTLE TEDEY (6) drops back in class, while ALDEBARAN MARCUS (3) also doesn't tend to win out of turn, but both are worth consideration. SELECTIONS:FARSTAR (4), SAINT EYES (2), ITS DIAMOND CREEK (5), LITTLE TEDEY (6)

OVERVIEW:COLBY ART (8) drops back significantly in class here and has been good in three runs for the new stable. He was a winner two starts back when starting off the back row, scoring in a time that would be good enough to cover these. He trails through behind a speedy beginner, so he shouldn't map too far off them. LORIMERMAJOR (7) likewise finds a more suitable race but hasn't won since the start of the year, although he's been runner-up six times. He has a tricky draw to overcome, but his form is better than most. BERYLS BOOTS (4) goes to the front row and has been much better this season. He'll need some luck with the map, but if he gets cover, he'll be thereabouts. TEMPTING TIGER (1) and POLLY PEACHUM (2) can map softly from their draws but are up in class and have minor claims, while YELLA (5) has burned my fingers too many times. Although he looks suited again, I'd prefer to see him step up before getting involved. BACK: COLBY ART (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:COLBY ART (8), LORIMERMAJOR (7), BERYLS BOOTS (4), TEMPTING TIGER (1)

OVERVIEW:CADENCE LANE (4) likes the standing-start conditions and may find this more suitable than recent outings. Her last win came from the tapes in Adelaide, where she was able to lead, and James Herbertson going aboard only adds confidence to her chances from what appears a suitable map. STARLIGHT RED (2) is a veteran mare suited by the front-row draw and standing-start conditions. She's likely to take up the running around the tighter-turning Echuca track, which is to her advantage given she races well here. Her only win this season came at this track and distance, so she'll give plenty of cheek for a long way. SUZYS DREAM (5) has a strong SP profile this preparation and has been racing consistently, including two seconds at this track. It's a slight concern she's yet to place under standing-start conditions, but her form is better than most. VAN DOREN (6) is her stablemate and does appreciate this track and the conditions. While the numerical form doesn't appeal, the drop in class does suit. MISS AVENGER (1) could have claims for the minor money if she gets away safely. SELECTIONS:CADENCE LANE (4), STARLIGHT RED (2), SUZYS DREAM (5), VAN DOREN (6)

OVERVIEW:ARRAPS (7) normally likes to lead in his races, so won't get that opportunity from this awkward draw, but his current form is hard to overlook in this moderate line-up. He's gone close in better races with a strong SP profile in his past four starts, so while he'll need some luck, with clear running late he can close strongly. ESERANZA (2) can improve sharply on her current form, reunited with Herbertson, as the pair combined for a close 2nd four runs back when able to find the lead from a wider draw than she has here. She can control things from the top end and take plenty of running down. ICANMOTOR (4) narrowly missed two starts ago when runner-up, and while he has a tricky draw, a good driver helps negate that. He can be a threat coming with one run. JOEYS HANGOVER (6) will find this grade more to his liking after mixing his form against stronger types. The draw makes things tricky, but keep him safe. BEYONDREASON (1) is hard to take on form but does get a stable switch and a soft draw, so is worth taking on trust. SELECTIONS:ARRAPS (7), ESERANZA (2), ICANMOTOR (4), JOEYS HANGOVER (6)

KARATA ARTEMIS (7) continues to race in great form and will again look to be driven quietly from barrier seven before storming home strongly late. SNOWIEWILLREV (5) won by a big margin when sitting off the speed in a solid tempo last start and may look to replicate that performance here. He clearly has plenty of ability on his day. REMMINGTON (8) is a late back-row runner who hasn’t had much luck of late. He should follow through the expected leader in LYNRYD SKYNRYD (1) and get his chance in the sprint lane, which may be just what he needs to return to form. MR BONDI (4) showed what he’s capable of with a strong second last start and will look to produce a similar performance here, which would have him right in the finish. IMPERIAL LAZ (6) could win this at his best and is another who will be hoping for some good tempo throughout. Selections: KARATA ARTEMIS (7), SNOWIEWILLREV (5), REMMINGTON (8), MR BONDI (4)

A maiden for the two-year-olds, where MYSTERY MAIL (4) should be breaking his duck after a strong string of performances in recent starts, including a painful watch for connections in the Group 2 Dandy Patch last start. VINJETTA (8) continues to run strong races without winning, and expect she may do something similar again here. BACK YA TRUCK UP (5) looks the best of the debutants after some strong trial performances and should look to sit on speed to give himself every chance. VINCENT THE THIRD (1) and IDEN JUST BECAUSE (2) haven’t been far away of late and will look to take advantage of their nice front-row draws to continue earning cheques for their connections. Selections: MYSTERY MAIL (4), VINJETTA (8), BACK YA TRUCK UP (5), VINCENT THE THIRD (1)

The maiden for the older horses, where you would expect the pole marker, ULTIMATE ATOM (1), to start favourite. She hasn’t had the best of luck in her runs thus far and does look like she may get crossed again here, but with any clear running, she clearly has the ability to take out a race of this class. VITESSE (4) should continue to improve with racing and could be suited by the longer trip here after having no luck last start. HARLEY GLENWOOD (7) was a good run despite the form guide showing a fifth placing last start, having sat wide for the final lap and battled on well. BLISSFULL RED (3) and VOODOO RANGER (5) will look to continue their consistent ways, earning cheques for connections in these sorts of races. Selections: ULTIMATE ATOM (1), VITESSE (4), HARLEY GLENWOOD (7), BLISSFULL RED (3)

ATOMIC BLACK (1) will look to take advantage of the favourable draw here over the short distance. He copped pressure early when crossed last week, where they went an extremely fast time over the middle trip. If he backs up well from that hard run, he looks the one to beat. EVERYTHING BUT THE (2) was nearly run down last start in a similar race and possesses good gate speed to find a nice position on speed and be in the finish. Those two look the fastest off the front row, unless KEAYANG FITZY (7) chances his arm from out wide over the short distance, which could very well happen. RAY DAN (3) was a strong winner two starts back in similar grade before galloping away when favourite in the Golden Apple last week. he should be able to slot in early and find a nice position to be running home strongly. SUPER AMERICAN (4), JOHN VINCENT (5) and MONTGOMERY BURNS (6) have all won or put in strong performances at their past starts and will be relying on some good tempo throughout to allow them to run into the finish from their awkward front-row draws. IRON CLAD (8) could be the one at odds, following the pegs from inside the back row. Selections: ATOMIC BLACK (1), RAY DAN (3), EVERYTHING BUT THE (2), IRON CLAD (8)

A lower-class race over the mile, where COLORADO GIRL (3) will look to use her sharp gate speed to cross those two inside her. She somewhat handed up last week when unable to run down the eventual winner, but suspect she may attempt an all-the-way victory here. JAY MILLER (5) is going for three wins on the trot and has been far too tough for them recently in similar grade. If he can find the death seat without doing too much work early from his awkward front-row draw, he could be too strong again. FIVE STAR SHARK (10) and SWEET AMOUR (11) have both put wins on the board lately and should get a nice run through from their back-row draws, while COOLANDCOLLECT (6) could start at overs from his wide front-row gate but may be running home strongly off a good tempo. Selections: JAY MILLER (5), COLORADO GIRL (3), COOLANDCOLLECT (6), SWEET AMOUR (11)

An even field comes together for the 50–55 rated horses over the sprint trip, where IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (1) will look to make use of her pole draw after drawing awkwardly in recent starts, and put together a sharp mile rate which shes capable of. DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8) should get a nice run through from inside the back row, following out the expected leader and getting his chance. KENYA (9) will no doubt be put into the race from his nice back-row draw and loom as the winner at some stage again. SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11) drops in grade with the claim and could be the one at odds with a strong tempo throughout. EYE SEE AMOUR (2), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (3) and REALLY SMARTIE (5) have all been racing well of late and could be in the finish with a nice run in transit. Selections: IFYALOVEMELETMEGO (1), DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8), KENYA (9), SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11)

Quite a strong open-class race, where we see the return of TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), first-up off the back of an Inter Dominion campaign. There looks to be a strong enough tempo for the first lap, with numerous horses possessing good gate speed off the front row, which should allow him to use his sharp speed late if close enough at the top of the straight. SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11) also resumes after competing in the Vicbred series recently and is another who would be suited by a solid tempo throughout and a nice cart into the race, which may come from CUSTOM HARLEY (9), who is normally driven aggressively at some point. ULTIMACTION (5) didn’t handle the standing-start event last week but was impressive when winning the start prior in nice time. She will be looking to find the pegs here, which may be reliant on whether WATERMELON SUGAR (3) decides to take a sit, as he should have enough speed to cross those inside him. MIKI PINS (2) resumes from a break and clearly has plenty of ability on his day, along with handy gate speed when asked. It’s hard to get a gauge on where he’s at, so the market may be the best guide. FREE THINKER (4) was solid enough first-up in the state and should improve from that run, while there are many other handy horses in the field who could be in the finish with luck in transit. MAGICIAN (1) will also look to take advantage of a rare good front-row draw. Selections: TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11), ULTIMACTION (5), CUSTOM HARLEY (9)

A mile race for no more than three-win mares, where STAYZBETTER (2) will look to kick up from her nice draw and attempt an all-the-way victory. She was a little disappointing last week in the Bandbox Prelude but gets her chance here over the short distance. OUR WILLOW (4) looks well graded and possesses sharp enough gate speed to find a position on speed. At her best, she is more than capable of taking this out. SPORT WATCHER (5) has been very consistent of late and will look to find a position on speed with cover. Those runners look the main fancies and class horses of the field from their draws, while ANGEL ROCKS (7) clearly has plenty of ability but will find it tough from the outside front-row draw. Selections: STAYZBETTER (2), OUR WILLOW (4), SPORT WATCHER (5), ANGEL ROCKS (7)

The usual competitive standing-start event for the middle-class pacers, where again manners will be key. DENVER MAN (3) meets the tapes for the first time and, if he steps safely, could be hard to beat sitting on speed. REPETITIVE (4) is always consistent in these types of races and will again look to find the pegs with his good standing-start manners, as will FLEETWOOD ROCK (2), who could run a race at odds with a soft pegs run. SETTEBELLO (5) normally begins sharply and will no doubt be at each-way odds again. ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8) is among the 10-metre horses who clearly have a class edge over those off the front. They will be relying on a good tempo throughout and a nice run in transit to finish off strongly, with ITSMENOTU (11) possibly looking the best of those chances. Selections: DENVER MAN (3), REPETITIVE (4), ITSMENOTU (11), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8)

Expect the last race on the card to be a quickly run mile, where SOHO TIGER LILY (2) will look to use her sharp gate speed to be first to the pegs and run them along at a handy clip. SHADES OF SILK (3) will no doubt sit on speed and ensure a solid tempo throughout, as he usually does, and is suited by the mile distance. BINALONG MATE (1) is first-up in the state and trialled nicely recently. He should get every chance up the sprint lane on his debut for the new stable to be winning off what looks a solid tempo. FAMILY REASONS (4) is racing well and just needs some luck in running to be in the finish from his front-row draw, while LETSGOBRO (8) has put in two performances good enough to run into the placings if gaps appear late. The same could be said for MOVES LIKE A LADY (10), who will no doubt be ducking through the field late, hoping gaps appear, as usual. Selections: BINALONG MATE (1), SOHO TIGERLILY (2), SHADES OF SILK (3), FAMILY REASONS (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: WHY NOW (6) starts from the 40m back mark here, but he looks a nice trotter on the rise for team Barker and he’s the horse to beat in the small field of six. He was a mammoth 37.8m winner as favourite at Mount Gambier on Wednesday, and before that started from the same handicap in races at St Arnaud and Hamilton, doing really well in the latter to be beaten just 4.1m by Keayang Minnesota. He’s lightly raced and looks to have the ability to overcome the big handicap. CONNIES PRESIDENT (5) looks the other key contender here off the 20m mark. He ran well for fourth behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last time out, which followed a dominant win from behind the leader at Horsham. He blundered his most recent stand start attempt, but a faultless display will have him right in this. ROBERT JOHN (2) hasn’t done much his last two but the first-up effort when a fast-finishing second at Maryborough was good, while MAORIS RETURN (1) chased home CONNIES PRESIDENT (5) for second here first-up in early October and his next best. BACK: WHY NOW (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: WHY NOW (6), CONNIES PRESIDENT (5), ROBERT JOHN (2), MAORIS RETURN (1)

OVERVIEW: SPOOK CROCKER (7) has had plenty of racing in recent days and will line up here for his fourth start since Saturday night. There at Melton, he ran well for fourth behind Captain Moonlight – beaten just 4.8m – and was then well back at Mount Gambier on Wednesday but rounded up most of the field to run second behind Ynobe Nova. The small field suits and he’s a promising type who has won eight of 27 starts. Stablemate OCEAN AVENUE (1) was trapped parked in that same race at the Mount and boxed on for fourth, and his second to the smart Jilliby Sniper at Melton in late October reads well for this, the promising MAJOR ROY (4) sat parked as a warm favourite to win at Ararat latest and all his recent form is sound, while LEWIELEWIS (5) might be the pick of the Aaron Dunn runners based off a good Mildura win and second placing through September. Plenty of hopes! BACK: SPOOK CROCKER (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SPOOK CROCKER (7), MAJOR ROY (4), OCEAN AVENUE (1), LEWIELEWIS (5)

OVERVIEW: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (4) led at Melton last week and copped some pressure in front before being grabbed by Ooh Ah Listah, who enjoyed a good run off the pace. It was a sound effort in a slightly higher grade race than this. He enjoyed a fruitful Tasmanian campaign before that with victory in a heat of the Dandy Patch series before a midfield effort in the $75,000 final. If he’s able to work forward and find the top, he should prove hard to beat. SMOKIN STREPO (3) was too far back when fifth at Mount Gambier on Wednesday but was able to run down Normandy Nugget two starts back to win at Ararat and that horse won well at Ballarat this week so the form reads well, SENNA STORM (5) was a dominant winner from the top at Kilmore on November 5 but didn’t do much either side of that, while PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (7) has a sticky draw but good gate speed and was a strong winner from the top at St Arnaud last time out. BACK: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (4), SMOKIN STREPO (3), SENNA STORM (5), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (7)

OVERVIEW: Two-year-old SOHO SPARKLE (6) was beaten as a short-priced favourite when she last stepped out at Ballarat back on October 29, but was caught parked there in a 56.2 last half. She ran really well through the Vicbred Super Series, with third placings in the qualifiers behind top-liners Ideal Frankie and Kahula before being well held in the Group 1 final. This is easier and she’s the deserving favourite. I AM MOLLY (7) ran a great race on debut for new trainer Sam Barker at Cranbourne on Sunday after finding the lead and giving expensive yearling purchase Mister Threeofive a real race. She was only beaten 2.5m in a 56.2 last half. She’s a key danger, as is BEACHBOY BRUCE (1), who trialled nicely when second behind five-time winner Rabada recently at Maryborough, and draws for a nice trip first-up. KEAYANG ALABAMA (2) might be next best, but is perhaps more likely a place hope behind the aforementioned rivals. SELECTIONS: SOHO SPARKLE (6), I AM MOLLY (7), BEACHBOY BRUCE (1), KEAYANG ALABAMA (2)

OVERVIEW: Wonderful edition of the Horsham Trotters Cup where you can make a case for a host of horses, notably FOUROUTOFFIVE (9). Nicholas O’Connor’s charge has been racing against some of the best squaregaiters here in Victoria, and arrives here after a ninth placing in the Group 3 Australasian Trotters Championship at Melton last weekend. He finished fifth in the Group 3 Dullard Cup prior to that, and while he’s been well beaten, his efforts are in stronger grade than most of his rivals. He shares the 20m handicap with MEADOW VALLEY STAR (10), but is good enough to overcome it with a faultless display. KEAYANG MINNESOTA (2) starts from the front as she looks to add a fifth-straight win to her recent record, MAXIMEZ (4) finished third in the recent St Arnaud Cup and looked like winning an SA Cup heat before that but galloped in the straight, while IZARRA (5) did a great job to finish fourth there at St Arnaud after an early break. Others can win, including local hope ARTIGAS (3) and MEADOW VALLEY STAR (10). BACK: FOUROUTOFFIVE (9) – 1 unit (each-way) SELECTIONS: FOUROUTOFFIVE (9), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (2), MAXIMEZ (4), IZARRA (5)

OVERVIEW: BLACK OPAL JACK (9) led and had every chance but was nailed late as favourite at St Arnaud on November 8 by the flying Huxham Chubb, who has now won her last three starts. He had been running well before that and looks one of the key contenders in an even looking 50-55 grade event. BATTON ROUGE (3) sat parked and did a great job to finish second, beaten a head, to Another Woods at Ararat last time, EXOTIC CHESTER (4) has been plain his last four starts but did lead and hold on for second in decent time at Ballarat going back on October 1, while MYDEEPESTDESIRE (8) claimed a well-deserved maiden success last time out at Ararat following great efforts at Maryborough and Melton, and is among the hopes alongside the first-up FAIR CHANCE (6). SELECTIONS: BLACK OPAL JACK (9), BATTON ROUGE (3), EXOTIC CHESTER (4), MYDEEPESTDESIRE (8)

OVERVIEW: This is an historic running of the Horsham Pacing Cup, which will serve as the first standing start race for pacers in Victoria since 2016. And what a competitive field it has drawn! I’m looking towards the backmarkers over the longer trip of 2700m, with Laura Wilson’s top-liner CALEXICO (11) seemingly getting in well with 20m. His last three starts have been strong, with a win at Swan Hill and third placing in track record time behind Storms Collide followed by a midfield finish last weekend in a hot Casey Classic at Melton. He’s a good horse who will be hard to beat. ULTIMATE VINNIE (12) had no luck in the Casey Classic and finished last, but did win a heat before placing third in the final of the recent SA Pacing Cup series at Globe Derby, COASTAL DRIVE (8) was well beaten last time but won a good race at Geelong back in early October and would be a huge threat if he stepped well and worked to the top from his 10m handicap, while CALEXICO’S (11) stablemate ALOT LIKE LOUIE (10) is fresh-up from a break but has trialled nicely and ran some great races in good company last campaign. The chances don’t end there! SELECTIONS: CALEXICO (11), ULTIMATE VINNIE (12), COASTAL DRIVE (8), A LOT LIKE LOUIE (10)

OVERVIEW: Here’s the third heat of the Stawell Pacing Cup, where emergency LOUGLE (1) looks the one to beat if he gains a start from the pole. He sat parked and won heat two of the series at Maryborough on Monday, which followed a race at Melton where he looked the likely winner in the straight before throwing his chances away by breaking and running to the outside fence. He’s a nice pacer on the rise. If he doesn’t start, then things are more open. I’m convinced NEATNTIDY (6) is flying for Aaron Dunn and had absolutely no luck when bolting for a run at Melton last weekend. She had the best closing sectionals in a race before that when seventh behind Jilliby Sniper and arguably should have won another event at the same track in early October but again had no luck. MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (9) ran superbly from last for third in the Swan Hill Pacing Cup before winning at Mildura latest and is a key contender alongside TO THE NINES (11), who rattled home from the tail for fourth behind LOUGLE (1) on Monday. SELECTIONS: LOUGLE (1), NEATNTIDY (6), MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (9), TO THE NINES (11) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R1 #6 WHY NOW (6) – 3 units (win) R2 #7 SPOOK CROCKER – 2 units (win) R3 #4 BUILDTHEMANASTATUE – 3 units (win) R5 #9 FOUROUTOFFIVE – 1 unit (each-way) EARLY QUADDIE 5,6/1,2,4,5,7/3,4,5,7/6,7 QUADDIE 2,4,5,9/3,4,8,9/5,6,8,10,11,12/1,6,9,11 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (1) is resuming but will strip fitter from three recent trial performances with the latest being a second behind SinceIleftyou at Melton. He strikes a very suitable assignment and should take beating. PETITE FOUR (3) has had gait issues in her two starts since resuming but she was able to finish fourth both times. She also finished a distant fourth at the trials last week but could show up if she delivers a fool proof display. NORTHERN SKYE (2) is a fast beginner and is drawn to receive every chance so she cannot be dismissed. CHAMPAGNESALLY (5) has broken stride at her past two attempts to date but she was placed at a Maryborough trial last week so she is worth thought. RINGMERONNIE (6) also galloped when on debut but is a possible improver. SELECTIONS: ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (1), PETITE FOUR (3), NORTHERN SKYE (2), CHAMPAGNESALLY (5)

OVERVIEW:CARPOPHORUS (5) finished strongly when sixth at his Victorian debut, followed with a handy third at Ararat then struck trouble when in a striking position last week. He has performed well enough at his first three local appearances to suggest he is a strong chance in this event. DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (3) is a maiden from 56 starts but she has been getting closer to the money. She finished off well from a nice trailing position when second in a race of similar standard last week. OSCAROO (7) worked home fairly well for third at Maryborough last outing but he wanted to hang in on the corners so the wide draw is a concern. SYNTAX ERROR (4) led out then took cover when third behind Suffarell Hill three starts ago and is likely to try and adopt similar tactics now. She is an experienced maiden but has been trotting consistently in recent times. SELECTIONS: CARPOPHORUS (5), DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (3), OSCAROO (7), SYNTAX ERROR (4)

OVERVIEW: AMALFI (4) is a former New Zealand pacer, which drew poorly and finished unplaced behind King Kasey (won again since) in a heat of the Stawell Cup at his Australian debut. He is better drawn and drops back in class so a better showing is expected. TRYX VIXEN (7) is a fast beginner and has been racing in good form. She progressed forward to race without cover and battled on well for fifth behind Interpretation in a strong race at Kilmore last outing. She is widely drawn again but looms as one of the leading chances. I SEE RED (2) settled in a rearward position and finished off well when fifth at Cranbourne last outing. He is better than his form reads and should make his presence felt. REIGN EM IN (1) is a fast beginner and a short course specialist so he can improve on his numerical form under these conditions. BACK: AMALFI (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: AMALFI (4), TRYX VIXEN (7), I SEE RED (2), REIGN EM IN (1)

OVERVIEW: NEDZA THRILLER (4) is a fast beginner and is racing in good form. He led out then took cover and chased hard when a close second at St Arnaud then followed with a third at Maryborough last week, where he attempted to lead throughout. This race is no harder and he should give another forward showing. AI SEDHAI (5) hasn’t been at his best form recently but he will appreciate a drop back in class and he is some chance of finding the lead so an improved showing is expected. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (2) gained a nice trail and finished off well when a close second behind Patnwill at Ballarat. He is drawn to gain a similar trip and should go well again. SILENT REVERIE (7) ran home well for third at Maryborough last week. She usually performs best when she is able to lead and she moves to the front line now so she is worth an investment. COURAGES LAW (8) enjoyed a lovely trip and finished off well for second behind Buckles For Berry then didn’t have much room in the straight at his latest fifth. He is awkwardly drawn but is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: NEDZA THRILLER (4), AI SEDHAI (5), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (2), SILENT REVERIE (7)

OVERVIEW:CRYPTO CROOK (3) settled midfield and finished off stylishly when a game second behind the smart pacer Bettor’s Ideal at Ballarat on Wednesday night. She dashed home and missed out by a slender margin at her debut performance so she appears to be ready to break through for a win. LIGHTNING ORO (9) performed very nicely at the trials prior to galloping shortly after the start and losing her chance on debut. She was looking to be positive early before she broke stride first up and her trial form would indicate she has the ability to test this field. MAKEOVER MIKI (8) is out of the Group 1 winning mare Gumdrops and was driven aggressively mid-race to circle the field and find the front at the 900m when third at a Melton trial effort on Tuesday. He is awkwardly drawn but must be kept safe. JOKIC (1) has performed okay in several recent trial performances and is a possible improver from the pole position. BACK: CRYPTO CROOK (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: CRYPTO CROOK (3), LIGHTNING ORO (9), MAKEOVER MIKI (8), JOKIC (1)

OVERVIEW:THE PASO DOBLE (10) broke stride several times and lost his chance at Geelong last outing. He led throughout and scored a runaway win at the trials since and he will take beating if he delivers a fool proof display. SONNYBOY (7) performed below expectations after racing on the outside of the leader throughout when sixth at Cranbourne on Sunday but his form prior was strong. He pushed forward to find the lead and dominated his rivals at Maryborough three starts ago so he is worth another chance. LIFE ON THE HILL (9) struck bother and lost his chance last outing. His form prior was strong and he is worth another chance. MONTANA MUSCLE (3) was doing her best work at the end when fourth behind Lindy Grace last week. She is working back into some form and strikes a suitable assignment now. POPPY POPSTAR (8) hasn’t been at her best form for some time but she is capable of improving under these conditions. SELECTIONS: THE PASO DOBLE (10), SONNYBOY (7), LIFE ON THE HILL (9), MONTANA MUSCLE (3)

OVERVIEW: I CHOOSE YOU (3) is a fast beginner and has been racing well against strong fields. He progressed forward to race without cover and battled on strongly for third behind Pass The Salt last outing so he will take catching if he can find the lead. DEEJAY DEX (11) was confidently supported and ran a very good race after a slow beginning when a close third behind Aetos Dynamis at Shepparton last outing. He is a risky beginner but will be competitive if he can get away safely. BUSLIN BRODY (1) can also be a little awkward at the start but he sustained a strong run from the 600m when a game second at Kilmore last outing so he is not without a chance. CHAMPAGNES (10) performs best when she is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but she did defeat a field of similar standard at Maryborough on October 30 so she cannot be left out of calculations. BACK: I CHOOSE YOU (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: I CHOOSE YOU (3), DEEJAY DEX (11), BUSLIN BRODY (1), CHAMPAGNES (10)

OVERVIEW: KENNYWOULD (11) has been racing really well against strong fields under the standing start conditions and led throughout to win the St Arnaud Cup at his latest attempt. It is different conditions this afternoon but it is a suitable line up so he must be respected. PARIS KAY (8) is awkwardly drawn but is racing well enough to figure in the finish. She was runner up in the Swan Hill Cup after doing plenty of chasing on October 15 and was runner up under similar conditions last week. SOVEREIGN TIGER (2) is a fast beginner and won over Zarski (won since) after finding the back on the leader at Kilmore five starts ago. He is ideally drawn to suit his racing pattern and should go well. OLIVER SMUDGE (10) faces a significant rise in class and is meeting some Metropolitan horses at only his fourth career start but he does appear to be a promising type so he cannot be underestimated. SELECTIONS: KENNYWOULD (11), PARIS KAY (8), SOVEREIGN TIGER (2), OLIVER SMUDGE (10)

OVERVIEW: MY FATAL CHARM (10) has performed very well in two starts since coming from Tasmania and is ready to break through for a win. She was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished quickly via the sprint lane when a close second behind Piastri last outing. BUBBLE OVER (9) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well for fifth at her latest appearance. She has returned from a spell in peak form and is worth an investment. BRAVE ART (8) is stepping up in class from her recent performances but she has been impressive recently. She led throughout and dashed home in a slick final half of 56.6 seconds to win comfortably at Maryborough last week. BETTOR DOO (3) trailed the leader Presidentialchange and just failed to run him down in what was simply a sprint up the home straight at St Arnaud. He has won two of his past five starts and should go well again. ANIMADO (6) is a versatile pacer and is steadily working back to his best form so he is worth an investment. BACK: MY FATAL CHARM (10) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: MY FATAL CHARM (10), BUBBLE OVER (9), BRAVE ART (8), BETTOR DOO (3)

OVERVIEW:THEBUCKSONYOU (8) is a handy 4yo pacer, which is resuming since a fifth at Mildura in August. He is versatile and beat a reasonable field at a Swan Hill victory towards the end of his last campaign so he must be respected. SHIRLEY NOT (7) won twice at Mildura in October and has the perfect trailing draw behind MIDNIGHT PIRATE (1) so she cannot be left out of calculations. She was held up for a run at a vital stage and chased hard for second on Thursday night. MIDNIGHT PIRATE (1) defeated an easier field on Thursday night but he kicked well clear at the 400m and sustained the run so he is worth thought from the pole position. MAGGACIS (2) endured a wide trip in the final circuit and battled on well when resuming on Thursday night. He should be fitter and is better drawn so he is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: THEBUCKSONYOU (8), SHIRLEY NOT (7), MIDNIGHT PIRATE (1), MAGGACIS (2)

OVERVIEW:THE LADYBIRD (11) settled in the second half of the field, angled wide in the home straight and finished off quickly for an eye-catching third at Shepparton last week. She gained a nice trail and got home best to win at Mildura prior so she is worth thought again. THE IRISHMAN (8) has been placed at his past four attempts and should be competitive against this class. He raced without cover throughout and battled on strongly for third at Mount Gambier last outing. PUNTO CALIENTE (7) ran home strongly from last and did well at Mildura on Thursday night. He is awkwardly drawn but should be hitting the line strongly again. WATCHING OVER US (6) finished off well for second behind THE LADYBIRD (11) on November 10. He was driven very aggressively in the early stages and peaked at the end on Thursday night but his efforts from off the speed prior were sound. DIAMOND KRUSHER (5) and GROVE DALE (2) are both fast beginners and are drawn to be prominent over sprint distance. SELECTIONS: THE LADYBIRD (11), THE IRISHMAN (8), PUNTO CALIENTE (7), WATCHING OVER US (6)

OVERVIEW: DALLAS MIKI (7) is a strong staying type that performs best when he is able to lead so he couldn’t have drawn worse. He progressed forward to find the front and dominated his rivals two starts ago and he has the class to test this field. He was gunned down by KYORETSU (8) on Thursday night but the extra distance of this event is in his favour. KYORETSU (8) began quickly, raced roughly and did well to remain pacing on the first turn to trail the leader and was very quick at the end when he won on Thursday night. He drops back to the second line now but should prove hard to beat again. NAROBI (2) is a South Australian trained mare that is making her Mildura debut. She has been racing consistently and trainer Peter Bain boasts a good strike rate at Mildura so she must be respected. PRIORITISE (6) sustained a long run to beat a field of similar quality on October 20. He has had a horror run with the barrier draw but he was placed under similar conditions on Thursday night and continues to perform strongly so he cannot be dismissed. SELECTIONS: DALLAS MIKI (7), KYORETSU (8), NAROBI (2), PRIORITISE (6)

OVERVIEW: SPRINGFIELD RIVER (6) joins trainer John Tormey and will appreciate a significant drop back in class for this assignment. He is versatile and is capable of running fast time so he warrants respect. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3) attempted to lead throughout when second at Mildura on Thursday night. He is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and looms as one of the leading chances. ACCELERE (5) is a fast beginner and performs best when he is able to lead. He has created a good impression at Mildura with a string of consistent performances and another bold showing is expected. He left a trailing position to park without cover and didn’t have a great deal of luck on Thursday night. ROJENBYE (1) finished off solidly from midfield to get up and defeat My Ultimate Rudi at Mildura on November 06. He is likely to gain an economical run from the ideal draw and is worth thought again, despite performing well below expectations on Thursday night. BACK: SPRINGFIELD RIVER (6) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SPRINGFIELD RIVER (6), CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3), ACCELERE (5), ROJENBYE (1)

OVERVIEW:CAULONIA TERROR (4) is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward as evidenced by his big victory at Mildura on Thursday night. He has struck peak form and will take beating again. OZZIE DAYBREAK (7) has been racing well but without luck and gets his chance to run a big race with the perfect trailing draw behind the likely leader HOOKLINEANDSINKER (1). He performed nicely again on Thursday night having worked into third at the end. G B BRAVE (3) ran home nicely for a game second when resuming on Thursday night and is worth a ticket each way. CALF PEN (5) ran a big race when he moved up without cover and went down fighting when second behind Bettorbust on November 06. He was driven aggressively early and raced fiercely thereafter so he had excuses on Thursday night. He continues to perform strongly against this class and should give another bold showing. HOOKLINEANDSINKER (1) hasn’t been at his best form recently but he tends to excel when he is able to lead over the sprint distance so he has the conditions to suit him here. SELECTIONS: CAULONIA TERROR (4), OZZIE DAYBREAK (7),G B BRAVE (3), CALF PEN (5)

OVERVIEW:EVA EXPRESS (6) led out then took cover when a close second behind Mystic Motiver in a stronger race at Kilmore two starts ago. She was caught wide early and had to be restrained to last from a similar poor draw on Thursday night but will find this to be a suitable assignment and should take tossing. SWEET LUCY LOU (5) possesses early speed and is a good chance of finding the lead. She raced without cover throughout at her latest fourth and should be competitive against this line up. LITLMAX (7) was confidently driven and showed promise when second on debut. She didn’t have much luck at her next few attempts and went down fighting after racing without cover on Thursday night so she could gain her maiden success at short notice. DARK AT MIDNIGHT (3) is a first starter for trainer Andrew Vozlic, which finished a distant third at his only trial performance. He is nicely drawn first up so he must be kept safe. SELECTIONS: EVA EXPRESS (6), SWEET LUCY LOU (5), LITLMAX (7), DARK AT MIDNIGHT (3)

OVERVIEW: OUR MONARCH (5) was heavily supported and was run down in the last stride when attempting to lead throughout at her debut performance. She should have benefited from that experience and is capable of going one better. BETTY CAROLINE (2) left the position behind the leader to race without cover when a brave second at Mildura last week. She is ideally drawn and should run a big race again. CRUEL MISTRESS (7) is an experienced maiden having had 33 attempts but she is getting closer to the money. She raced without cover when a game second behind Cheddar Cheese on November 06 and was the runner up again at Mildura on Thursday night. SANTA CASA LEVI (3) was checked with 700m remaining and lost approximately four lengths when unplaced on Thursday night and is a possible improver from his good draw. BACK: OUR MONARCH (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: OUR MONARCH (5), BETTY CAROLINE (2), CRUEL MISTRESS (7), SANTA CASA LEVI (3)

OVERVIEW: WINSHEMAY (3) followed some good trial performances with a soft debut victory then was spelled. She finished strongly from a long way back when third on resumption and she appears to have a promising future. MY ULTIMATE HENRY (5) progressed forward to find the lead, ran along at a genuine tempo and was run down late in fast time on Thursday night. He is racing well and looms as one of the leading chances again. SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (6) has done well in three local starts and should make his presence felt. He was a runaway winner on November 06 then attempted to lead throughout and was run down by the handy South Australian pacer Hilltop Crunch at his latest second. TAMALIA (1) was placed after trailing the leader at St Arnaud on November 08 and she led throughout to beat easier opposition on Thursday night. She is drawn to suit her racing pattern and may be able to take the next step forward. KAIDENBOY (2) makes his debut for trainer Kate Attard and took on a stronger field at his latest Ararat fifth. He has claims along with CLARENDEN ARCADIA (4). BACK: WINSHEMAY (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: WINSHEMAY (3), MY ULTIMATE HENRY (5), SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (6), TAMALIA (1)

OVERVIEW: HESASTAR (6) is the one of only two horses in this event that did not contest the meeting at Mildura on Thursday so he comes into the race with fresh legs. He was driven aggressively from the same draw and was able to score after racing without cover throughout in a field of similar quality last outing so he will prove very hard to beat again. EAGLEYE (4) was a late withdrawal on Thursday night but his overall form has been sound and he strikes a suitable assignment now. INDIANAS SON (5) settled midfield and held his ground over the latter stages at Mildura on Thursday. The small field will assist his chances and he is capable of filling a place. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (3) was driven for early speed but couldn’t get across to the markers and was shuffled back in the field mid-race so he didn’t enjoy the best of luck at Mildura on Thursday. He gets his chance to improve under these conditions. THE AFRICAN QUEEN (2) gained a nice trail and battled into a distant fourth on Thursday night. She is a place chance from her good draw. BACK: HESASTAR (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HESASTAR (6), EAGLEYE (4), INDIANAS SON (5), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (3)
